investigation_atlas.initial:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a production transparent sprite atlas for a top-down environmental investigation game set in rural China.
Generate a square 2048 x 2048 PNG with a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. A strict invisible 4-column x 4-row grid makes 16 equal 512 x 512 cells. Exactly one separate sprite centered in every cell. Every sprite must fit completely inside its cell with at least 64 pixels of clear transparent padding on every side. No grid lines, no letters, no labels, no backdrop. Arrange the following subjects in exactly this reading order, from top left across each row:
Row 1: (1) little river water-sampling dock: wooden pier with small teal testing hut and water sample crates, (2) rural livestock farm: low terracotta-roof barn with ivory walls and tiny fence, (3) rural fish pond: small enclosed turquoise pond with reeds and wood walkway, (4) recycling yard: small open shed with three distinct colored recycling containers and neatly bundled material.
Row 2: (5) village houses: compact group of three traditional Chinese village homes with dark green tile roofs, ivory walls and terracotta doorways, (6) reservoir sampling dock: larger wooden T-shaped dock and teal monitoring cabinet, (7) aquaculture fish cages: three floating square net pens with orange floats, (8) fertilizer factory: compact cream industrial shed, two ochre silos and short chimney, no smoke.
Row 3: (9) lakeside restaurant: warm orange-roof waterside Chinese pavilion restaurant with terrace and parasol, (10) water intake station: small sage-green pump house with two blue pipes, (11) mountain creek sampling point: stepping stones, small wooden footbridge and teal measuring post with a little rust-orange mineral-water puddle, (12) mountain guesthouse: charming two-story ivory inn with terracotta roof and small pine tree.
Row 4: (13) stone quarry: irregular cluster of pale grey stepped stone ledges with tiny ochre excavator and stone blocks, (14) abandoned mine entrance: dark mine tunnel in warm ochre rock outcrop with wood beams and a short rail, (15) irrigation fields: small rectangular green and golden crop rows with a blue irrigation channel and wooden gate, (16) environmental field investigator character: full body friendly adult scientist wearing cream cap, teal jacket, ochre backpack, dark trousers and boots, holding a little sample case; facing slightly toward viewer.
Style/medium: beautiful editorial flat-color block illustration, distinctly designed silhouettes and authentic hand-drawn organic shapes, premium cozy game art. Slightly elevated three-quarter top-down orthographic view with visible front faces. All 16 subjects share identical perspective, lighting and palette. Crisp clean edges. Solid large color blocks only. Subtle simple solid-color side faces allowed, NO gradients, NO noise or paper texture, NO airbrushing, NO line art, NO photographic detail. Friendly mature art, not pixel art, not 3D rendering.
Palette: creamy ivory, sage green, deep pine green, turquoise blue, terracotta orange, muted ochre, warm stone gray. Objects have carefully chosen contrasting colors, no harsh black.
Constraints: exactly 16 isolated fully visible subjects, correctly ordered, transparent gutters; no ground tiles or circular bases, no scenery connecting cells, no text, no numbers, no visible borders, no decorative frame, no watermark. Make the character occupy around 75% of cell height and the buildings around 70% of each cell width.

No gaps, no frames, no panel borders, no text. They will be cut into three independent game maps.
Camera for every panel: true overhead bird's-eye terrain-map illustration, looking directly down; do not draw a horizon, sky, side-view mountains, buildings, characters, icons, symbols, labels, bridges, trees, bushes or furniture. TOP PANEL — clear-water river valley: warm sage-green grassy ground. Pale warm cream footpaths run on both sides and branch across the left and right broad empty meadow areas. A small empty ochre agricultural plot in lower left. At least 65% of panel is open land. No objects.
MIDDLE PANEL — tranquil reservoir: sage and pale olive ground, a large irregular turquoise lake occupies the central-right area, extending from x=40% to x=87% and y=18% to y=82%. Cream shoreline contours, generous empty meadow land on all four margins and especially left side. Pale cream path loops outside the shoreline and branches to the edges. One low ochre earthen dam strip at lower right. No buildings, no objects.
BOTTOM PANEL — mineral mountain stream: pale sage grass with broad flat warm-stone-gray rock outcrops along the upper edge and upper-right corner, simple layered contour shapes seen overhead; a narrow turquoise stream winds diagonally from upper right to lower center-left. No gradients, no painted shading, no soft shadows, no texture, no grain, no noise, no tiny scattered markings, no realistic rendering, no 3D.
